name: Type Of Price 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of price and information about the price.

AVER.name: Average
AVER.definition: Price is an average execution price.

AVOV.name: Average Override
AVOV.definition: Price is an override of the average price.

COMB.name: Combined
COMB.definition: Price is composed of the combined expenses (used in the UK market).

GREX.name: Gross Of All
GREX.definition: Price is a gross execution price. The price is an all inclusive price, ie, including all charges, fees, and taxes.

LIMI.name: Limit
LIMI.definition: Price is the limit price of a limit order, eg, a customer might put in a limit order to sell financial instruments at 67 or to buy at 60.

NET2.name: Net
NET2.definition: Price is a net price, ie, net only of local broker's commission, local fees and local taxes.

NDIS.name: Net Disclosed
NDIS.definition: Price is net to the disclosed client.

NET1.name: Net Of All
NET1.definition: Price is a net price, ie, net of all charges, fees and taxes.

NUND.name: Net Undisclosed
NUND.definition: Price is net to the client undisclosed (used in the UK market).

NOGR.name: Notional Gross
NOGR.definition: Price is notional gross (used in the UK market).

PARV.name: Par Value
PARV.definition: Price is equal to the nominal or face value of the instrument.

RDAV.name: Rounded Average
RDAV.definition: Price is a rounded average price.

STOP.name: Stop
STOP.definition: Price is a stop price used in an order to buy. The order becomes a market order when the financial instrument trades at or above the stop price after the order is submitted. In an order to sell the order becomes a market order when the financial instrument trades at or below the stop price.
